findings.text: the no-join branch states 'the review was not stored' from promotion's failed join alone, but plan_review.store_delivered_reviews (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:4376) stores every delivered report through its directory regardless of dispatch.json's run id, so a report composed with run_id null that an earlier plan-build pass stored reads as not stored on the receipt

the only guard for the new field is the un-landed test in the run's scratch directory, /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261103T070914711408-.../measure/test_plan_review_store_receipt.py, and no file of that name exists in the repository, so no committed test fails if the field regresses and the guard dies with the node's /tmp

the base-red claim quotes logs/base.log, which ran a five-case earlier draft at 08:29 including test_a_joined_report_reads_written_across_a_second_promotion, while the delivered test holds four cases and was copied into both arms at 08:57; the KeyError outcome is certain from the base arm lacking the field, but the cited red log does not correspond to the delivered test

items.diff: read commit by commit from 4da2af6c05 to da698581c3: 31ab20badf adds _composed_plan_review_directory, _plan_review_store_outcome and the receipt attachment, and da698581c3 adds the evidence fragment; nothing else changed.
items.done_when: the done_when names a test in a temporary home plus no added failing id against a base arm; the manifest records both arms and their logs, and the head log reports 2 failed, 758 passed with the four added cases in the head-only population.
items.goal: the node's goal is that a plan review's promotion receipt says whether its review was stored; reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:2614 _plan_review_store_outcome and reckon/crew/promotion.py:1845 attach that field, read back off the delivery the store recorded.
items.manifest: read; it records status complete, both gate arms with their logs, no added failing id, 0 added failures, and per-dimension rubric lines.
items.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py and the evidence fragment; every path in the three-file diff is one of the first three declared and the fourth declared path is untouched.

justifications.durability: the four assertions in the scratch test_plan_review_store_receipt.py each redden on a real regression (dropping the field raises KeyError; dropping the store read makes the refused case read written), but no test file exists in reckon/tests that runs them, so nothing in the repository fails if this change regresses.
justifications.evidence: the evaluated gates are recorded, not claimed: /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261103T070914711408-a-plan-reviews-receipt-says-whether-the-review-was-stored/logs/gate-head.log opens with its revision, tree, module and command and ends EXIT=1, and its failure ids are a strict subset of the base arm's, but the base-red negative control in logs/base.log predates the delivered test file.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:2585 follows the module's private-helper and docstring idiom beside _plan_review_record_for_promoting_run, and promotion.py:1843-1846 attaches the field where the receipt is assembled; no plan, sprint or ticket identifier appears in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:2621-2632 reads written off the stored delivery and the refusal reason off its sidecar, but the no-join branch at reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:2643 states the review was not stored from a failed join alone, which plan_review.py:4376 makes possibly false.
justifications.reuse: the addition reuses _delivered_plan_review_for_run, _plan_review_crew_run_id and _plan_review_report_root rather than opening a second path into the store; its write-path resolution at promotion_checks.py:2577 answers the no-join case the existing run-id scan at promotion_checks.py:2694 cannot.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in `git diff --stat 4da2af6c05..da698581c3` is inside the declared write paths, and the fourth declared path (docs/figures/) carries nothing.
